caseName: Moragne v. States Marine Lines, Inc.
caseNameFull: Moragne v. States Marine Lines, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 900.] The Solicitor General is invited to submit a brief as amicus curiae and to participate in oral argument. The parties and the Solicitor General requested to brief, in addition to other issues presented, question whether The Harrisburg, 119 U. S. 199, should be overruled.
